gui_actions.note: Split to parts has no job flag.

gui_actions.cli: re-run the job or orca-slice with the new file (stateless)

job parts[] type modifier + settings; orca-slice --modifier box@X,Y,Z:SX,SY,SZ:key=v

gui_actions.note: Needs a host-painted shape plus depth; use a modifier volume (job parts[] type modifier) instead.

job paint layer color value N (filament N)
